dialogues.speaker: Miroslava
dialogues.text: ...No matter how you look at it, we Savage Bears already have six members. We just need a few more people to finally take over the entire Snezhnograd.

dialogues.speaker: Krylov
dialogues.text: It's a super good plan, Boss, but I don't think snowmen alone are enough...

dialogues.speaker: Anfissa
dialogues.text: Exactly! Just having snowmen is no fun at all! If we have more friends, everyone can play together, have snowball fights, and —Oh! We can play even better pretend!

dialogues.speaker: Anfissa
dialogues.text: Just like those amazing people who sing in the theater... If we host fun stuff like that, I bet more people would want to join us!

dialogues.speaker: Krylov
dialogues.text: Alright, little girl, stop looking at us like that! We're not just playing house here. The Savage Bears are a proper gang, and you don't build a crew just by playing games!

dialogues.speaker: Krylov
dialogues.text: Yeah! We need members who can actually do things and think big! We're gonna pull off something huge and make sure the whole Snezhnograd knows our name!

dialogues.speaker: Anfissa
dialogues.text: Yay! We're gonna be famous all over Snezhnograd!

dialogues.speaker: Miroslava
dialogues.text: Ahem! Well, the ideas are good... Anfissa has provided some valuable suggestions, and Krylov is right, too.

dialogues.speaker: Miroslava
dialogues.text: Now, we need to call an official meeting to properly map out the Savage Bears' development plan for the upcoming year...
